Fresh food / great prices
Jan 2020
Am an American living in Nha Trang for 18 months. Needless to say I have tried most all the sushi establishments. I tried Samurai today and it was excellent! The miso soup was rich and actually had tofu chuncks in it. The panco fried vegetables were hot and really good taste. Had the Dynamite roll and the Avacado roll and both were fresh. This place is a great value and you do not have to give up quality. They were actually busy and the meal was brought in due time as I ordered it. Highly recommend!!!

Fast and delicious. very good value.
Dec 2019
Came to Sushi Samurai when they were very busy but only waited 5 minutes before they found us a table. The booth seating is very comfortable and the place is clean. All our orders arrived quite quickly (10 to 15 minutes). The rolls were excellent and the french fries and chicken wings for the kids were also very good. better than McDs fries. They serve a freshly made mango smoothy and real watermelon juice that is killer. My favorites were the scallop Temaki, Salmon Sashimi, Philadelphia roll and Dynamite roll. (Big Shrimp). 4 of us had our fill of food and drinks and the bill was under 600K. ($26).

Unprofessional, incompetent service
Nov 2019
Upon out arrival at 21:25 right after sitting at a table the waitress simply told us (4 people, paying customers, intended to leave a nice sum at their restaurant) that we have 5 minutes to order and half an hour to eat and leave. With a smile on her face. I understand that the kitchen has to close at one point in the evening but telling your customers that they soon need to leave before they even ordered is not only unprofessional but outrageous. This is NOT how hospitality works. You can bring it up a much nicer way. And if we stay longer then 10 pm then what? Is it so unusual? As long as we consume? The even more incompetent manager confirmed what she said, and apologised but she didn't even try to make us stay. Certainly we left. One of the worst restaurant experiences ever despite the promising menu. Unfriendly staff. Avoid the place or arrive early. Btw there are some great other sushi restaurants in the hood. :)

Vietnam tastes like dishes of this restaurant!
Jul 2018 • Friends
To say sincerely , I went abroad for the first time.I am the fourth grade student of University in Kyiv,Ukraine and study at Vietnamese language program,so I went to Vietnam for practice.I had tried the Vietnamese cuisine earlier,before going to Sushi Samurai ,but it was not actually as good as it was in this restaurant.
The first thing I have noticed is low price of dishes. Traditional Vietnamese food costs there approximately 2-3 dollars,bevereges are among 2 and 3 dollars. 
Also I liked the great choice of dishes.As there were Vietnamese cuisine as well as international. What I like the most were sushi.(Tokatsu rolls).Combination of pork ,cheese and lettuce tasted for me like never before and costed about 3 dollars!Sake sashimi was good as well.So I have no wonder why the restaurant is called like this.
Moreover I haven`t even noticed a difference between Ukrainian and Vietnamese price,though Ukraine is a cheap country for tourism.
So I definitely recommend this place and will visit it again in the future.
